assumptions.statement: Overall and key-area polygons are repository-provided provisional rough geometry, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and spatial positions require full recalculation after official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road rights-of-way, ownership, utilities, heritage, fire, and existing-building conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, parcel demolition, engineering alignment, or capacity conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, event calendars, test authorization, and incident-response responsibilities are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Programs require governance, safety, legal, and operational design before trial.

assumptions.statement: Scenario designs use no personal or live operational data.
assumptions.impact: Any future pilot must complete data minimization, authorization, cybersecurity, accessibility, and human-review assessment.
